title: KNOT Offshore Partners LP Announces 2nd Quarter 2026 Earnings Results Conference Call
summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP) ( “ the Partnership”) plans to release its financial results for the 2 nd Quarter of 2026 prior to opening of the market on Friday, September 4, 2026. The Partnership also plans to host a conference call on Friday, September 4, 2026, at 9:30 AM (Eastern Time) to discuss the results for the 2 nd Quarter of 2026. All unitholders and interested parties are invited to join via the live webcast link on the Partnership’s website: www.knotoffshorepartners.com . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same link following the conclusion of the live call. Our 2 nd Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation will also be available at www.knotoffshorepartners.com prior to the conference call start time. About KNOT Offshore Partners LP KNOT Offshore Partners LP owns, operates and acquires shuttle tankers primarily under long-term charters in the offshore oil production regions of Brazil and the North Sea.
